title: When Do Gaussian Priors Fail? A Latent Geometry Investigation of RL Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space. For base generation this default is unproblematic; under reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, however, it carries a structural limitation. The standard VAE's KL term does not merely ignore mode structure - it actively taxes separation and tightness. When data are multimodal, the ELBO optimum compresses distinct modes into an overlapping latent. RL fine-tuning amplifies this overlap: the score network is under-resolved on the saddle region between modes, dynamic-to-variational amplification rises sharply, and the collapse boundary beta_c is pushed far above its variational scale. On the real alanine-dipeptide Boltzmann distribution, a Gaussian-prior VAE collapses at beta_c = 0.224 while a mode-tracked Gaussian-mixture prior collapses at 0.00316, a 71x gap from the same pipeline. translated_title: 高斯先验何时失效？强化学习微调的潜空间几何研究
translated_abstract: 潜在扩散模型几乎普遍在VAE潜空间上采用高斯先验。对于基础生成任务，这一默认选择并无问题；然而在强化学习微调下，它带有一种结构性局限。标准VAE的KL项不仅忽略了模态结构——它还主动惩罚模态的分离性与紧凑性。当数据为多模态分布时，ELBO的最优解会将不同的模态压缩进相互重叠的潜空间中。强化学习微调会进一步放大这种重叠：得分网络在模态之间的鞍点区域分辨率不足，动态-变分放大效应急剧上升，崩溃边界β_c被推至远高于其变分尺度的位置。在真实的丙氨酸二肽玻尔兹曼分布上，高斯先验VAE在β_c = 0.224时崩溃，而模态追踪的高斯混合先验在β_c = 0.00316时才崩溃，同一流程下两者相差71倍。我们将这一差距追溯至一个单一的几何中介量 d_min/(2σ₀)，……
tldr: 本研究揭示了高斯先验VAE在强化学习微调下的结构性缺陷——KL项主动惩罚模态分离导致潜空间模态重叠并引发模型崩溃——并指出崩溃阈值相差71倍的根源可归结为单一几何量 d_min/(2σ₀)。
en_tdlr: This work uncovers a structural flaw of Gaussian-prior VAEs under RL fine-tuning—where the KL term actively penalizes mode separation, causing latent mode overlap and model collapse—and traces the 71x gap in collapse thresholds between Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture priors to a single geometric mediator, d_min/(2σ₀).
